note: Two release binaries built from the same tree, one on each UI, run minutes apart on the same machine. `rust_embed` bakes the UI into a release build, so the arms cannot be swapped inside one binary. Median of nine opens after a warm-up.
do-not-compare: These absolutes are this container's. Phase 8's release figures were taken on a different machine roughly three times faster on the same work — its before column was 271 ms where this one is 790 ms. Only a column against the column beside it means anything here.
